correctness.rationale: For cubic prisms the precise tie-handled update flips iff >=2 neighbors agree, decreasing monochromatic-edge count. A same-colored rung forces global alternating same-colored rungs, exactly two for even n; otherwise all rungs are opposite and stable configurations correspond bijectively (two-to-one) to cyclic independent equality-transition sets of parity k=n mod 2. Cyclic independent-set coefficients prove the polynomial and Lucas/mod-six reduction for all n>=3. Direct exhaustive raw-state tests at n=3..9 independently confirm each energy coefficient. Nontrivial cycles are impossible, and waiting for at most 3n productive updates proves E[T]<=6n^2.

value.rationale: The entire natural one-spin-stable/absorbing energy spectrum of the smallest periodic cubic strip is determined, with exact frustrated ground-state multiplicity, mod-six finite-size correction and Lucas exponential metastable growth. This answers a complete finite-volume dynamical census, supplies a normalization for frozen-state ensembles, and contrasts many absorbing configurations with a uniform polynomial expected hitting-time bound. The specific energy statistic is the canonical monochromatic-edge Lyapunov energy, not an arbitrary slice.
